target: ODF1.2 specification functionality baseline plus CUPS printing
priority: Stage active; Words paused and columns preserved; further Sheets catalogue work waits
completion_rule: Each feature requires relevant read/render/edit/save/reopen, semantic or visual oracle, and CUPS evidence where meaningful. Schema validity, byte retention, signature recognition and upstream name counts are separate evidence and cannot close a functional requirement.
version_policy: Default new native documents to1.2; preserve newer source versions. Explicit optional operations needing newer syntax retain their established version upgrade behavior. Missing manifest versions are repaired to1.2 in serialized exports while exact edit-source manifest bytes remain available to history.
coverage_note: Initial area inventory; decompose into normative element/attribute/behavior requirements before a full conformance/completion claim.

areas.evidence: ZIP/package preservation and archive-part undo exist; plain-package and manifest gates added.
areas.remaining: Encrypted packages, signature verification/writing, RDF/package metadata semantics, flat XML and broader package cases remain.

areas.evidence: New native ODT/ODS/ODP use1.2;1.3/1.4 source versions retained by editing tests.
areas.remaining: Template and additional ODF document kinds, explicit export-version policy and full consumer/producer implementation-defined documentation remain.

areas.evidence: Native paragraphs/runs/styles, shaping/bidi, lists, tabs and editing/history; Stage scoped character/paragraph formatting, transient typing and exact replacement ranges.
areas.remaining: Complete text/frame/anchor layout, section/column flow, vertical/ruby/embedded/color fonts and broader editing behavior remain.

areas.evidence: Words page number/count fields in page stories work.
areas.remaining: General variables/references/notes, generated indexes/TOC, tracked changes and field editing/layout remain.

areas.evidence: Words structural tables/merged/nested cells and sizing; Stage table rendering; Sheets native cells/arrays/references.
areas.remaining: Full styles/borders/number formats, structural formula rewrites, table editing in Stage, and spreadsheet range/merge/row/column tools remain.

areas.evidence: OpenFormula-specific signature census finds312/392 available and80 missing; existing numerical/type/reference corpora provide function-specific evidence.
areas.remaining: All required function semantics, operators/reference intersections/3D, settings, named-expression/locale behavior and explicit evaluator-group conformance remain.

areas.evidence: Stage shapes, transforms, paths, masters, embedded images and text; direct affine resize/center-rotation/line-endpoint gestures with exact source/history and raster checks. Native sibling/containing-group stacking commands have candidate source/history and independent order checks. Native grouping/one-level ungrouping, nested object/group selection, aggregate affine gestures, batch ordering/deletion and selection-aware history have independent source/model/UI checks. Native Stage layer-set consumption resolves global/page/master scopes, screen/print visibility and protected source subtrees; independent model/UI/source/raster/CUPS checks cover selected cases. Native detached layer editing supports scoped definitions/known reference renames, visibility/protection/title/description, explicit missing-name repair, object/group assignment, exact content/archive/selection history and candidate screen/print validation; native-stage-layer-edit and actual control/source/print corpora provide feature-specific evidence.
areas.remaining: Broader layer/reference interoperability and source edge cases beyond the selected corpus; broader fixed-label/navigation rewrites; full group styles/metadata/anchor/event/glue-point and identity-reference rewrites; object clipboard workflows; complete connectors, custom geometry, fills/strokes, charts/3D/OLE/embedded content, Word anchors and authoring tools remain.

areas.evidence: Basic slides, masters, scene editing and presentation navigation.
areas.remaining: Placeholder/theme/notes/settings fidelity, transitions, timing, animation/media and presentation authoring remain.

areas.evidence: Opaque original package parts may be retained.
areas.remaining: Native chart models/rendering/editing, references and chart ODF round trips remain.

areas.evidence: Opaque source retention is not functional support.
areas.remaining: Native form controls/database bindings and standalone ODB support remain.

areas.evidence: Some event/link references guard destructive edits; unknown source stays retained.
